Easy.title: Knock down 1 center skill-shot card
Easy.explanation: Knock down any one of the four raised center cards for its 1,000,000-point skill-shot award.

Easy.title: Move the secondary-mission selector with either ramp
Easy.explanation: Shoot the right ramp to raise or the left ramp to lower the secondary mission shown on the playfield and backglass.
Easy.source_location: The A-Team rules - Secondary mission selection

Easy.title: Complete the B.A. target bank once
Easy.explanation: Knock down the full B.A. target bank once in one game.

Easy.title: Collect a gift from the Barrel Hole
Easy.explanation: Shoot the Barrel Hole on the right and collect the gift it draws.

Medium.title: Complete any main mission objective
Medium.explanation: Start a main mission at the van and finish its displayed objective before the mode ends.

Medium.title: Contact Mr. Lee with 10 van shots
Medium.explanation: During active main missions, shoot the van ten times to discover Hannibal's alter ego and contact Mr. Lee.

Medium.title: Start any secondary mission at the Jeep
Medium.explanation: Select a secondary mission with the ramps, then shoot the Jeep to start it.

Medium.title: Activate SuperTargets with 50 bumper hits
Medium.explanation: Register fifty bumper hits to activate the special scoring on the green targets.

Hard.title: Start TNT Multiball
Hard.explanation: Complete ten TNT-box hits, then make the required start shot to begin the three-ball TNT Multiball.

Hard.title: Complete the Run Away video mission
Hard.explanation: Start Run Away at the Jeep and successfully pass all fifteen groups of police cars.
Hard.source_location: The A-Team rules - Run Away video mode

Easy.title: Defeat the Ringmaster once
Easy.explanation: Raise the Ringmaster and land the full sequence of hits needed to defeat him once.

Easy.title: Spell R-I-N-G once
Easy.explanation: Complete the four RING rollovers to advance the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

Easy.title: Shoot the left ramp 3 times
Easy.explanation: Make three clean left-ramp shots in one game.

Easy.title: Collect a Side Show award
Easy.explanation: Enter the lit Side Show and collect its awarded feature.
Easy.source_location: Cirqus Voltaire guide - Side Show award

Medium.title: Complete the Acrobats Marvel
Medium.explanation: Shoot the right ramp four times to finish Acrobats and light Super Spinner.

Medium.title: Defeat the Ringmaster twice in one game
Medium.explanation: Complete two full Ringmaster battles before the game ends.

Medium.title: Start Juggler
Medium.explanation: Complete the JUGGLER targets, then make the lit start shot.

Medium.title: Start Highwire Multiball
Medium.explanation: Qualify and lock the required balls, then begin Highwire Multiball.

Hard.title: Collect a Ringmaster Jackpot
Hard.explanation: Reach a Ringmaster battle and collect one lit Ringmaster Jackpot shot.

Hard.title: Collect Voltaire's Multiple Jackpots
Hard.explanation: Stack qualifying multiballs, return to one ball, then shoot the left ramp during the short collection window.
Hard.source_location: Cirqus Voltaire guide - Voltaire's Multiple Jackpots

Easy.title: Complete the lower-left drop bank
Easy.explanation: Knock down all three lower-left drop targets once.

Easy.title: Complete the lower-right drop bank
Easy.explanation: Knock down all three lower-right drop targets once.

Easy.title: Complete the upper-left drop bank
Easy.explanation: Knock down all three upper-left drop targets once.

Easy.title: Complete the B-E-T rollover lanes
Easy.explanation: Light B, E, and T in the upper rollover lanes once, using lane change as needed.

Medium.title: Complete one upper-playfield card hand
Medium.explanation: Light every card rollover on the upper playfield to complete one hand.

Medium.title: Collect a Draw Poker award
Medium.explanation: Light the Draw Poker saucer from the left inlane, then shoot the saucer and take its wheel award.

Medium.title: Start timed Millions
Medium.explanation: Complete all three drop-target banks to begin timed Millions scoring.

Medium.title: Raise and shoot the center ramp
Medium.explanation: Hit the center target to raise the ramp, then make the center-ramp shot.

Hard.title: Collect 1,000,000 during timed Millions
Hard.explanation: Start timed Millions, then complete any full drop bank before the timer expires.

Hard.title: Start Multiball and collect the Jackpot
Hard.explanation: Lock two balls at the raised center ramp, start Multiball, and complete the required center-ramp shots for Jackpot.

Easy.title: Spell F-I-R-E once
Easy.explanation: Roll through all four FIRE inlane and outlane letters, using lane change to move the unlit letter.

Easy.title: Start 2X Playfield
Easy.explanation: Hit the bell three times to start the timed 2X playfield multiplier.

Easy.title: Load the Cannon once
Easy.explanation: Shoot the right ramp once to load the Cannon for a center-target attempt.

Easy.title: Complete one AC/DC, T.N.T., or ROCK target bank
Easy.explanation: Finish any one of the three labeled target banks once.

Medium.title: Make 6 ramp shots in one game
Medium.explanation: Complete six total shots across the left and right ramps before the game ends.

Medium.title: Make 8 loop shots in one game
Medium.explanation: Complete eight total shots through the left and right loops before the game ends.

Medium.title: Fire the Cannon and hit a lit target
Medium.explanation: Load the Cannon at the right ramp, then time the fire button to hit one of its lit playfield targets.

Medium.title: Start 3X Playfield
Medium.explanation: Start 2X with three bell hits, then land three more bell hits before the multiplier expires.

Hard.title: Start any main Multiball
Hard.explanation: Qualify and start Jam, Tour, or Album Multiball at the right ramp.

Hard.title: Complete a song objective and collect its Encore progress
Hard.explanation: Finish the active song's shot objective and secure the resulting Encore progress before the game ends.
Hard.source_location: AC/DC guide - Song completion and Encore

Easy.title: Make the flashing skill shot
Easy.explanation: Move the flashing top lane with the flippers and plunge through it for the skill-shot award.

Easy.title: Reveal the next Route 66 award
Easy.explanation: Shoot the right ramp once to open its diverter and reveal the next Route 66 award.

Easy.title: Collect 1 spark plug
Easy.explanation: Make the major shot marked with a yellow arrow to collect one spark plug.

Easy.title: Collect 1 Track Combo
Easy.explanation: Use the engine ramp or right orbit to feed the upper flipper, then complete its lit follow-up shot.

Medium.title: Collect any Route 66 award
Medium.explanation: Reveal the next Route 66 award with one right-ramp shot, then shoot the ramp again to collect it.

Medium.title: Win Race Today
Medium.explanation: Start Race Today at the right ramp, accelerate with the left flipper, and shift with the right when prompted.

Medium.title: Collect a Multiball Jackpot
Medium.explanation: Reach Multiball and make one lit Jackpot shot.

Medium.title: Complete a Challenge at the Pit
Medium.explanation: Collect a flashing blue car part, start its Challenge at the Pit, and win the race with flashing shots.

Hard.title: Complete the four-shot Catch Me sequence
Hard.explanation: Collect Catch Me from Route 66, then make the right ramp, skid-pad ramp, engine, and Pit shots in order before their timers expire.

Hard.title: Collect a Multiball Super Jackpot
Hard.explanation: During Multiball, shoot the upper loop and immediately follow it with the skid-pad ramp.

Easy.title: Complete the green stoplight targets
Easy.explanation: Hit or spot all three flashing green stoplight targets.

Easy.title: Make 1 Freeway
Easy.explanation: Use an inlane to light a timed Freeway arrow, then shoot the corresponding full orbit before it expires.

Easy.title: Shoot the main ramp once
Easy.explanation: Make one full main-ramp shot to collect its ramp award and bonus multiplier.

Easy.title: Shoot the eject hole once
Easy.explanation: Land the ball in the eject hole once; on standard settings it also spots stoplight progress.

Medium.title: Advance the stoplight to Yellow
Medium.explanation: Complete all green stoplights so the main stoplight advances to Yellow.

Medium.title: Make 3 Freeways on one ball
Medium.explanation: Light and collect three timed Freeway orbit awards before the ball drains.

Medium.title: Reach Red Light
Medium.explanation: Complete the green and yellow stoplight sets to reach Red.

Medium.title: Start Police Chase
Medium.explanation: Reach Red, then shoot the main ramp to run the red light and begin Police Chase.

Hard.title: Escape and start Multiball
Hard.explanation: Start Police Chase, complete all nine stoplight targets, then make the lit Escape shot.

Hard.title: Collect the Hideout Jackpot
Hard.explanation: After escaping into Multiball, shoot the main ramp to collect the Hideout Jackpot.

Easy.title: Complete the Birds drop-target bank
Easy.explanation: Knock down all five Birds drop targets once.

Easy.title: Complete the Milk drop-target bank
Easy.explanation: Knock down the full Milk drop-target bank once.

Easy.title: Make 1 Tiger Ramp shot
Easy.explanation: Shoot the long left Tiger Ramp once.

Easy.title: Collect one DogHouse award
Easy.explanation: Use the lit left inlane to open Bulldog's mouth, then shoot the DogHouse scoop.

Medium.title: Complete both Birds and Milk banks
Medium.explanation: Finish the Birds bank and the Milk bank once each in the same game.

Medium.title: Collect one SeaFood wheel award
Medium.explanation: Light the Fishbowl ramp, make the center ramp, and take the SeaFood wheel award.

Medium.title: Spell B-A-D C-A-T-S once
Medium.explanation: Complete enough drop-target banks to finish one full BAD CATS letter cycle.
Medium.source_location: Bad Cats guide - BAD CATS letters

Medium.title: Reach 5X bonus
Medium.explanation: Complete the top rollover lanes enough times to advance the bonus multiplier to 5X.

Hard.title: Light and collect the Jackpot at the Fishbowl ramp
Hard.explanation: Complete seven required target banks to light Jackpot, then shoot the center Fishbowl ramp before draining.

Hard.title: Reach 7X bonus and collect a SeaFood award
Hard.explanation: Max the rollover bonus multiplier at 7X and collect one lit SeaFood wheel award in the same game.
Hard.source_location: Bad Cats guide - Max bonus and SeaFood

Easy.title: Light the spinner with the first inline target
Easy.explanation: Knock down the first inline drop target to light the spinner.

Easy.title: Collect 1 D-O-L-L-Y letter
Easy.explanation: Hit any lit DOLLY standup target to add one DOLLY letter to bonus.

Easy.title: Collect 1 P-A-R-T-O-N saucer letter
Easy.explanation: Plunge or shoot the top saucer to collect its currently lit PARTON letter.

Easy.title: Score the 5,000 return lane
Easy.explanation: Send the ball through the 5,000-point return lane below the spinner once.

Medium.title: Rip the lit spinner for at least 10 spins
Medium.explanation: Light the spinner, then make one spinner shot that registers at least ten spins.

Medium.title: Reach 3X bonus at the inline targets
Medium.explanation: Knock down the first three inline targets to advance the bonus multiplier to 3X.

Medium.title: Complete D-O-L-L-Y once
Medium.explanation: Collect all five DOLLY standup letters in one game.

Medium.title: Complete P-A-R-T-O-N once
Medium.explanation: Collect all six PARTON letters from the top saucer sequence.

Hard.title: Complete D-O-L-L-Y P-A-R-T-O-N once
Hard.explanation: Finish the full eleven-letter DOLLY PARTON bonus sequence in one game.

Hard.title: Reach 5X bonus and complete P-A-R-T-O-N
Hard.explanation: Clear all four inline targets for 5X and complete the PARTON saucer letters in the same game.
Hard.source_location: Dolly Parton guide - Max bonus setup

Easy.title: Complete the Area 51 targets once
Easy.explanation: Light all three lower Area 51 targets once to light Alien Scan.

Easy.title: Complete the F-18 targets once
Easy.explanation: Light all three upper F-18 targets to start Hurry-Up.

Easy.title: Make 1 Alien ramp shot
Easy.explanation: Send the ball up the Alien ramp once toward its escalating awards.

Easy.title: Complete the three I-D-4 lanes once
Easy.explanation: Light all three angled ID4 lanes to advance the bonus multiplier.

Medium.title: Start Red Alert
Medium.explanation: Make three shots up the left and right ramps to begin the thirty-second Red Alert mode.

Medium.title: Collect a Hurry-Up at the left orbit
Medium.explanation: Complete the F-18 bank, then shoot the left orbit before the Hurry-Up timer expires.

Medium.title: Collect a Combo Jackpot
Medium.explanation: Use an inlane to light an orbit combo, complete it, then hit the lit Combo Target.

Medium.title: Collect an Alien Scan award
Medium.explanation: Complete the Area 51 targets to light Alien Scan, then complete the bank again to collect its award.

Hard.title: Collect the 100,000,000 Computer Virus award
Hard.explanation: Shoot the Computer Virus sinkhole five times to reach 100%, then collect the lit right-orbit award.

Hard.title: Collect the 160,000,000 Multiball Super Jackpot
Hard.explanation: Advance through the lock, orbit, and three-ramp Jackpot waves, then shoot the Combo Target for Super Jackpot.
Hard.source_location: Independence Day rules - Multiball Super Jackpot

Easy.title: Start any Major Villain mode
Easy.explanation: Qualify a Major Villain at the Bat Phone and start its first phase.

Easy.title: Start any Minor Villain mode
Easy.explanation: Qualify and start any Minor Villain encounter.

Easy.title: Collect a Mystery award
Easy.explanation: Light Mystery and shoot its award shot once.

Easy.title: Light one shot multiplier at Commissioner Gordon
Easy.explanation: Build Commissioner Gordon progress and light one playfield shot multiplier.

Medium.title: Complete any Major Villain phase
Medium.explanation: Start a Major Villain and finish one complete phase.

Medium.title: Complete any Minor Villain mode
Medium.explanation: Start and finish one full Minor Villain mode.

Medium.title: Start Villain Multiball
Medium.explanation: Complete Villain Multiball qualification and make its start shot.

Medium.title: Complete any King Tut mode
Medium.explanation: Qualify King Tut and complete one of his mode objectives.

Hard.title: Complete Mr. Freeze
Hard.explanation: Reach Mr. Freeze and complete the full villain encounter.

Hard.title: Light all five shot multipliers
Hard.explanation: Use Commissioner Gordon progress to light all five major-shot multipliers in one game.

Easy.title: Complete the R-E-F-L-E-X targets
Easy.explanation: Hit every REFLEX target once to complete the bank.

Easy.title: Complete the four drop targets once
Easy.explanation: Knock down the full four-target bank once to earn 2X bonus and relight Bag O' Tricks.

Easy.title: Collect one Bag O' Tricks award
Easy.explanation: Shoot the Bag O' Tricks when lit and accept one displayed award.
Easy.source_location: Dr. Dude guide - Bag O' Tricks

Easy.title: Complete Reflex 1-2-3 once
Easy.explanation: Make the three numbered Reflex shots in order once.

Medium.title: Collect Heart of Rock 'n Roll
Medium.explanation: Make the Heart shot when lit to collect that Element of Coolness.

Medium.title: Collect Magnetic Personality
Medium.explanation: Make the Magnetic Personality shot when lit to collect that element.

Medium.title: Collect Gift of Gab
Medium.explanation: Make the Gift of Gab shot when lit to collect that element.
Medium.source_location: Dr. Dude guide - Gift of Gab

Medium.title: Bring the Mixmaster online
Medium.explanation: Collect all three Elements of Coolness so the Mixmaster becomes ready.

Hard.title: Become Super Dude and collect a Gazillion
Hard.explanation: Collect all elements, complete the Mixmaster sequence, start Multiball, and make the lit Gazillion shot.

Hard.title: Complete Reflex 1-2-3 twice in one game
Hard.explanation: Finish the full numbered Reflex sequence two separate times before the game ends.

Easy.title: Complete the Ducks targets
Easy.explanation: Hit every Ducks standup target once to complete the group.

Easy.title: Collect the 1,000,000 right-ramp award
Easy.explanation: Advance the right-ramp value and make the ramp when its 1,000,000 award is lit.

Easy.title: Collect a Ferris Wheel award
Easy.explanation: Light the Ferris Wheel and shoot it to collect one displayed award.

Easy.title: Make 1 Hurricane ramp shot
Easy.explanation: Send the ball around the full Hurricane ramp once from the playfield.

Medium.title: Start Clown Time
Medium.explanation: Light all six parts of the Clown's Face, then shoot the Hurricane ramp to start the frenzy.

Medium.title: Collect a Mystery Wheel award
Medium.explanation: Qualify and collect one award from the backglass Mystery Wheel.

Medium.title: Reach unlimited millions on the Comet ramp
Medium.explanation: Make the timed Comet sequence through 100K, 200K, and 300K, then collect a 1,000,000 shot.

Medium.title: Collect a Quick Score at the Ferris Wheel
Medium.explanation: Shoot the Ferris Wheel immediately after the ball crosses the right return-lane switch.

Hard.title: Start Multiball
Hard.explanation: Qualify and lock the required balls at the Juggler, then begin Multiball.

Hard.title: Spell P-A-L-A-C-E and collect the Jackpot
Hard.explanation: Finish PALACE, then make the lit Jackpot shot before the game ends.

Easy.title: Pick up 1 passenger
Easy.explanation: Make the currently lit passenger pickup shot once.

Easy.title: Complete the C-A-B top lanes
Easy.explanation: Light C, A, and B at the top lanes once, using lane change as needed.

Easy.title: Collect the 25,000 Spinout skill shot
Easy.explanation: Plunge the ball so the Spinout saucer stops on 25,000 and awards a passenger pickup.

Easy.title: Complete the L-O-L-A drop targets
Easy.explanation: Knock down all three LOLA targets before their ten-second reset.

Medium.title: Complete the P-I-N-B-O-T drop targets
Medium.explanation: Knock down all three PINBOT targets before their fifteen-second reset.

Medium.title: Pick up 3 different passengers
Medium.explanation: Collect three different lit passenger pickups in one game.

Medium.title: Collect the 100,000 Spinout skill shot
Medium.explanation: Plunge into the Spinout saucer and stop its rotating value on 100,000.

Medium.title: Advance Airport value 3 times
Medium.explanation: Light Airport from the left inlane, then complete CAB to collect and advance it three times.

Hard.title: Pick up all 5 passengers and collect Jackpot
Hard.explanation: Collect GORBY, PINBOT, DRAC, LOLA, and SANTA, then shoot the lit Jackpot before its timer expires.

Hard.title: Start Multiball
Hard.explanation: Light and collect the required ball locks, then begin Taxi Multiball.

Easy.title: Make 1 Comet ramp shot
Easy.explanation: Shoot the left Comet ramp once.

Easy.title: Complete the Shooting Gallery targets
Easy.explanation: Hit the full Shooting Gallery target set once.

Easy.title: Complete the Ball Toss targets
Easy.explanation: Hit the full Ball Toss target set once.

Easy.title: Collect a Ferris Wheel award
Easy.explanation: Light the Ferris Wheel from an inlane, then shoot it and take one award.

Medium.title: Complete 1-2-3 and start Double Scoring
Medium.explanation: Complete all three top rollover lanes to start the timed Double Scoring feature.

Medium.title: Collect a Boomerang hole award
Medium.explanation: Shoot the Boomerang hole while its advance award is lit.

Medium.title: Collect a Mystery Wheel award
Medium.explanation: Qualify the backglass Mystery Wheel and collect one of its awards.

Medium.title: Make 2 Cyclone ramp shots in one game
Medium.explanation: Complete the right-side Cyclone ramp twice before the game ends.

Hard.title: Collect the timed Jackpot with 3 right-ramp shots
Hard.explanation: Make the right ramp three times before its timer expires to collect the current Jackpot.

Hard.title: Light and collect the 1,000,000 Comet ramp
Hard.explanation: Advance the Comet value until 1,000,000 is lit, then make the Comet ramp shot.

Easy.title: Shoot the Shuttle Ramp once
Easy.explanation: Make one full left Shuttle Ramp shot.
Easy.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Shuttle Ramp

Easy.title: Enter the Pinbot mini-playfield once
Easy.explanation: Shoot the lit Shuttle Ramp and send the ball into the upper Pinbot area.
Easy.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Pinbot area

Easy.title: Complete the three 5K standups
Easy.explanation: Hit all three 5K standup targets to advance the bonus multiplier.

Easy.title: Shoot the Heartbeat Ramp once
Easy.explanation: Make one full center Heartbeat Ramp shot.
Easy.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Heartbeat Ramp

Medium.title: Activate the Bride's voice
Medium.explanation: Advance the face sequence to the Activate Voice step and complete it.
Medium.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Activate Voice

Medium.title: Complete the first eye
Medium.explanation: Advance the face to Partial Optical Link and complete the first eye.
Medium.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - First eye

Medium.title: Reach 5X bonus at the 5K standups
Medium.explanation: Complete the three 5K standup targets enough times to advance the bonus multiplier to 5X.
Medium.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Bonus multiplier

Medium.title: Collect 3 Pinbot values in one game
Medium.explanation: Enter the upper Pinbot area three times and collect three successive Pinbot values.
Medium.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Pinbot values

Hard.title: Collect the lit Jackpot at the left lane
Hard.explanation: Light Jackpot with right loops, then shoot the far-left lane before its timer expires.
Hard.source_location: Bride of Pinbot guide - Collect Jackpot

Hard.title: Complete Metamorphosis
Hard.explanation: Complete both eyes to start Multiball, then return both balls to the face far enough to trigger Metamorphosis.
